summary: Add browser chat with streaming replies, model selection, server history, tool calls, usage costs and Markdown export.
description: Add the reference browser chat application to react-router. It includes streamed replies, model selection, a deterministic time tool, contact extraction and Markdown export, with usage metadata and local browser tests. History lives on the server in memory by default; SQLite is an implementation choice for restart persistence. There is no authentication: possessing a chat URL grants access. Configure an OpenRouter key for live requests.
seoDescription: A streaming OpenRouter browser chat app for React Router, with model selection, tools, contact extraction, usage details and Markdown export.

projectExamples.title: Model exploration notebook
projectExamples.description: Use the reference chat to compare model replies and export conversations. Add private accounts and durable storage before treating it as a personal hosted notebook.

projectExamples.title: Contact extraction workbench
projectExamples.description: Start with the included contact extraction form and extend its validation and review interface. New extraction schemas or integrations are application work.
